amendment_rule: Any change to this verdict must be published as a dated successor artifact stating what changed and why, alongside the version it replaces. A silent edit invalidates the pre-registration property of the entire SUI stream. The underlying realized outcomes are immutable (the grade ledger and its hash); a successor verdict can only re-interpret them under a superseding standard.

discharged.rule_1_not_a_win_rate: HONOURED. This artifact reports the cohort's tier. It states no win rate, no accuracy figure and no '22/22'. The 22 appears only as the cohort size (n = 22) and in the count of interval misses (4 of 22), both of which are measurements of the cohort, not claims about the model.
discharged.rule_2_metrics_are_UNDEFINED: HONOURED. The ledger's safe_* wrappers return the UNDEFINED sentinel on the metrics this cohort cannot define; this verdict reports them as UNDEFINED, not as coerced floats.
discharged.rule_3_bootstrap_is_UNDEFINED: HONOURED. Where single-class y_true makes every bootstrap resample evaluate to 0.0, the cluster and iid bootstrap paths short-circuit to UNDEFINED. No coerced bootstrap numbers reach this verdict.
rule_4_what_may_be_claimed: The pipeline resolved end to end: freeze -> maturity -> grade -> hash-signed ledger -> publication. The 22 canonical batch-B rows joined byte-for-byte to their frozen predictions on committed_record_id and committed_prediction_hash.
The maturity and completeness/coverage gates fired as specified (integration_duration_days = 14.0, window_completeness reported per row).
realized_net was computable from real on-chain fee_growth deltas.
The interval-coverage count, which is a real measurement, is reported above (4 of 22 outside the frozen interval).

binding_reporting_rules.one_line_commitment_verbatim: If, on 2026-08-27, the 22 batch-B predictions produce zero realized traps, we will publish that as EVIDENCE AGAINST @1% the model - the zero_trap_contradiction: P(0 traps) = Pi(1-y_prob) over the frozen y-vector = 0.0021433554373314957, i.e. zero traps is a 0.21% event under the model, below the 1% level -> EVIDENCE AGAINST @1% - together with the interval-coverage count, and the statement that roc_auc/pr_auc/brier and precision/recall are UNDEFINED in the zero-trap ledger (the grader's safe_* wrappers return the UNDEFINED sentinel on single-class y_true; safe_precision/safe_recall gained the degenerate guard on 2026-08-18). We will not report it as 22/22. If any pool traps, the verdict is decided by the triggers in v2, and in particular a row with y_prob < 0.01 that traps is EVIDENCE AGAINST outright.
binding_reporting_rules.republished_as_UNDEFINED_note: The names come from the standard's own embargo list, read at build time. Each is UNDEFINED for this cohort unless the ledger defines it; the ledger has no field capable of saying UNDEFINED, so this verdict carries it — the same office the standard assigned to itself before any outcome existed.
rules_verbatim: It must NOT be reported as '22/22 correct', '100% accuracy', or any win-rate. An all-safe prediction set in an all-safe window is a null result. '22/22' converts a measurement of the window into a claim about the model.

In the zero-trap branch roc_auc, pr_auc, brier, precision, and recall are UNDEFINED in the ledger (the SUI grader's safe_* wrappers return the UNDEFINED sentinel on single-class y_true; safe_precision and safe_recall gained the _degenerate guard on 2026-08-18 to match safe_roc_auc/safe_pr_auc/safe_brier - the ledger no longer carries coerced precision=0.0/recall=0.0 floats and gate_5_degenerate no longer records a coerced-metric failure on a legitimate zero-trap ledger). Republish any of them as UNDEFINED if a downstream copy coerced them.

The BOOTSTRAP blocks: with single-class y_true the cluster and iid bootstrap paths short-circuit to UNDEFINED (degenerate guard), so no coerced bootstrap numbers reach the ledger. Verified by reading the guard; re-verify on the real ledger.

What MAY be claimed: the pipeline resolved end to end (freeze -> maturity -> grade -> hash-signed ledger -> publication); the maturity and completeness/coverage gates fired as specified; realized_net was computable from real on-chain fee_growth deltas; and the interval-coverage count, which is a real measurement.
